recognize_zh: 一顆巨噬細胞內塞滿數百個 2–4 µm 的小卵圓形酵母菌，每個有偏心的新月形紫色核與周圍清亮暈圈（halo），這是莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）的典型樣貌。
features: Macrophage distended by innumerable small (2-4 µm) oval yeast forms
Each organism with a crescent-shaped purple nuclear cap and surrounding clear halo
Uniform size without budding hyphae or capsule
Displaced macrophage nucleus at the edge of the cell
Background red cells and a single lymphocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage packed with numerous small, uniform oval intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 µm. Each organism has an eccentric crescent of basophilic nuclear material and a surrounding clear halo; no kinetoplasts are identified. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); confirmation with GMS/PAS stains, culture or antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are more elongated/sausage-shaped.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic without halos and Pneumocystis cysts are extracellular in foamy exudate; GMS morphology helps separate them.
Candida is larger, stains less crisply on Wright stain, and may show pseudohyphae; culture separates them.
